zh.summary: 用同一個任務串起需求、設計、規格、程式與測試，展示已完成行為、修正證據與仍待驗事項。
objectives: 建立需求到作品與驗收的追溯。
展示正常、負向與過期結果情境。
依六題整合評量說明取捨與限制。

readingGuide.goal: 建立需求到作品與驗收的追溯。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的完整作品、指定提交、測試與重現紀錄，以及教師指南六題。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 展示紀錄能將每項完成主張連到作品、提交與真實證據。

sections.heading: 展示一個可以被追問的工程成果
paragraphs: 成果展示要回答使用者的哪個問題被改善、系統如何做到，以及憑什麼相信它符合規格。漂亮截圖可幫助定位畫面，但無法取代程式版本、測試及實際操作。
選同一筆合成資料串起 problem.md、wireframe.svg、spec.md、architecture.md、app.py、tests/、README.md 與 Git 紀錄；不要每份作品換一個案例，讓追溯斷開。

sections.heading: 像帶人沿著工程紀錄走到現場
paragraphs: 先說明要解決的問題，再看設計與施工依據，最後到現場驗證關鍵行為。現場看起來能動，仍要確認與原先約定相符。
軟體展示也保留同一條線：要求、決策、修改及證據。遇到尚未完成的部分，說明差距與下一步，讓接手者知道可以使用的範圍。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從問題走到可核對成果
blocks.description: 每個節點連到一份作品；同一情境貫穿全程。

items.title: 問題與設計
items.body: 誰遇到什麼問題，操作與狀態如何安排。

items.title: 規格與架構
items.body: 哪些條件必須符合，資料在哪裡處理。

items.title: 交付與限制
items.body: README 重現、尚未實作及下一步。

sections.heading: 先準備一張需求追溯表
paragraphs: 以「缺漏不得產生完整報告」為例：problem 說明交接前的缺漏風險，wireframe 呈現修正方式，spec 定義負向情境，rules.py 拒絕匯出，AppTest 及瀏覽器確認提示與下載狀態。
表內記實際檔名、測試名稱與提交，結果欄只填本次已執行的觀察。規格文件中的預期不是測試結果；教師參考答案也不是學員作品完成證明。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜展示用追溯欄位
rows: 預期 ValueError 與介面負向測試
輸入變更使舊結果失效
app.py 的快照及失效條件
乾淨環境與同儕重現分別記錄

sections.heading: 用三種情境展示關鍵行為
paragraphs: 第一段保留文件類型空白，說明缺漏提示與為何不能下載完整報告；第二段補齊並檢查，核對下載 JSON；第三段清空欄位，確認舊成功與下載失效。
若現場操作失敗，保存實際狀態並指出待修，不切換預錄畫面後宣稱已通過。可以補充先前紀錄，但要標明版本與觀察時間，不能混成當次結果。

sections.heading: 用六題整合評量檢查是否串得起來
paragraphs: 教師指南六題分別檢查需求、Agent、人機互動、規格與架構、實作與驗證、交接治理。回答時指出作品與理由，不能只背術語；多人版問題要說明原型未實作哪些控制。
每題依「具體可操作、作品可追溯、限制與下一步」評閱。尚無真人作答時保留未評量，不能由答案已公開推定學員理解。

blocks.heading: 展示前核對
paragraphs: 用自己的真實資料位置填寫，仍只使用合成案例。
blocks.code:
指定版本／提交：
問題與本次範圍：
正常、缺漏、過期結果的操作：
對應 spec 情境與測試結果：
曾失敗、修正及回歸證據：
README 重現方式：
未實作／未驗與下一步：

sections.heading: 把展示結果變成明確交接決定
paragraphs: 若作品與驗收一致，可以接受本機教學原型；若要求十人共用，另確認身分、授權、資料保存與部署。原型展示通過不會自動滿足後一種要求。
最後保留接受範圍、待修項目與負責人。課程的收束是可追溯且能重現的成果，不將一次展示當成所有業務與使用者情境都已驗證。

exercise.environment: 自己的完整作品、指定提交、測試與重現紀錄，以及教師指南六題。
steps: 選一條要求建立問題—設計—規格—實作—驗收追溯表。
操作缺漏、補正及輸入變更，核對實際 JSON 與限制。
依六題指出作品與理由，記錄接受範圍、待修與未驗。
exercise.expected: 展示紀錄能將每項完成主張連到作品、提交與真實證據。
exercise.check: 包含負向情境與限制；無真人展示或評量時，不代填通過。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Connect requirements, design, specification, code and tests through one task, demonstrating completed behavior, repair evidence and pending work.
objectives: Trace requirements to artifacts and acceptance.
Demonstrate normal, negative and stale-result scenarios.
Explain tradeoffs and limits through the six integrated assessment questions.

readingGuide.goal: Trace requirements to artifacts and acceptance.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your complete artifacts, specified commit, test/reproduction records and the six questions in the instructor guide.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A demonstration record linking each completion claim to artifacts, commits and actual evidence.

sections.heading: Present Work That Can Be Examined
paragraphs: A demonstration explains the user problem improved, how the system addresses it and why its behavior meets spec. Screenshots can locate an interface but cannot replace versions, tests and actual operations.
Use one synthetic record across problem.md, wireframe.svg, spec.md, architecture.md, app.py, tests/, README.md and Git history. Changing cases between artifacts breaks traceability.

sections.heading: Follow the Engineering Record to the Site
paragraphs: Explain the problem, inspect design/construction commitments, then verify key behavior on site. An apparently working installation still needs comparison with the agreement.
Software demonstrations likewise connect requirements, decisions, changes and evidence. Identify gaps and next steps so successors understand the usable scope.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Problem to Verifiable Results
blocks.description: Each node links to artifacts, with the same scenario throughout.

items.title: Problem and design
items.body: Who has the problem, and how actions/states are arranged.

items.title: Implementation and verification
items.body: Commits, diffs, rules and interface evidence.

items.title: Delivery and limits
items.body: README reproduction, absent features and next steps.

sections.heading: Prepare a Requirements-traceability Record
paragraphs: For incomplete data not producing complete reports, problem describes omission risk before handoff, wireframe shows correction, spec defines negative scenarios, rules.py rejects export, and AppTest/browser checks examine feedback and download state.

Record actual filenames, test names and commits. Fill results only from this execution: specification expectations are not test outcomes, and the teacher solution does not establish a learner’s completed work.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Demonstration Traceability Fields
rows: Incomplete data cannot export as complete
Expected ValueError and negative interface tests.
Another person can restart the app
Clean-environment and peer reproduction recorded separately.

sections.heading: Demonstrate Three Key Scenarios
paragraphs: First leave document type blank and explain omission feedback and unavailable complete download. Next fill and check it, inspecting downloaded JSON. Finally clear the field and verify old success/download invalidation.

If live operation fails, retain its state and needed repair. Do not switch to prerecorded footage and call the live trial passed. Earlier records can supplement the demonstration with explicit versions and observation times.

sections.heading: Connect the Course Through Six Integrated Questions
paragraphs: The instructor guide’s questions cover requirements, Agents, HCI, specification/architecture, implementation/verification and handoff/governance. Cite artifacts and reasons rather than terminology alone. For multiuser questions, identify controls absent from the prototype.
Assess specificity, traceable artifacts, limits and next steps for each answer. With no actual learner response, keep assessment unperformed; published answers do not establish understanding.

blocks.heading: Pre-demonstration Checklist
paragraphs: Use actual artifact locations with synthetic cases only. The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records version/commit, problem/scope, normal/omission/stale-result operations, spec/test results, failures/repairs/regressions, README reproduction and absent/unverified work with next steps.
blocks.code:
指定版本／提交：
問題與本次範圍：
正常、缺漏、過期結果的操作：
對應 spec 情境與測試結果：
曾失敗、修正及回歸證據：
README 重現方式：
未實作／未驗與下一步：

sections.heading: Turn Results into an Explicit Handoff Decision
paragraphs: Consistent artifacts and acceptance can support acceptance as a local teaching prototype. A ten-user request separately requires identity, authorization, retention and deployment work; prototype demonstration does not satisfy those automatically.
Retain accepted scope, repairs and owners. The course concludes with traceable, reproducible results, without treating one demonstration as verification of every business or user scenario.

exercise.environment: Your complete artifacts, specified commit, test/reproduction records and the six questions in the instructor guide.
steps: Choose a requirement and trace problem, design, specification, implementation and acceptance.
Operate omission, correction and input-change scenarios, inspecting actual JSON and limitations.
Use the six questions to explain artifacts and reasons; record accepted scope, repairs and unverified work.
exercise.expected: A demonstration record linking each completion claim to artifacts, commits and actual evidence.
exercise.check: Include negative scenarios and limits. Without human demonstration or assessment, do not fill in a pass.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 一張完成畫面截圖最適合支持什麼？
options: 某版本某時刻的畫面觀察
rationales: 需保留版本與觀察範圍。

en.prompt: What can a finished-screen screenshot most appropriately support?
options: A screen observation at a particular version and time.
rationales: It does not cover every scenario.

zh.prompt: 展示發生錯誤，應如何處理？
options: 用舊影片替代並稱當次通過
保留現況與待修，另標先前證據的版本

en.prompt: An error occurs during the demonstration. What should happen?
options: Replace it with an old video and call this trial passed.
Keep current state and repairs, labeling earlier evidence by version.

zh.prompt: 六題參考答案已備好，可以推定什麼？
options: 評量材料存在，學員結果仍需實際取得
rationales: 出題與理解是不同層次。

en.prompt: The six model answers are ready. What follows?
options: Assessment material exists; actual learner results still need to be obtained.
rationales: Materials and understanding are different layers.
